finding.headline: "The Child Who Went Quiet"
finding.problem: "My first born used to tell me everything. Now she hides in her room. I'm losing her and I don't know how to reach her without the baby between us."
finding.person: Mum whose 9-year-old became sullen/distant since the baby; "you don't love me now" said once, then silence.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (reconnecting with the school-age sibling) — emotionally potent". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
